samplingProtocol: Approach 1 (Reef Area): This approach was carried out to observe the fish species in coral reef areas. In shallow waters within the limits of safe SCUBA diving, transect underwater visual survey was carried out. In this approach, two experienced divers conducted survey of fish population within a quadrant of 10 m x 1m, at 5-10 m depth. The species present in the column of water at each station was identified and individuals of each species were counted and recorded on slates.

samplingProtocol: Approach 1 (Reef Area): This approach was carried out to observe the fish species in coral reef areas. In shallow waters within the limits of safe SCUBA diving, transect underwater visual survey was carried out. In this approach, two experienced divers conducted survey of fish population within a quadrant of 10 m x 1m, at 5-10 m depth. The species present in the column of water at each station was identified and individuals of each species were counted and recorded on slates.
